title: mentha × agardhiana
intro: Mentha × agardhiana, commonly known as Bergamot mint, is a natural hybrid plant derived from the combination of Mentha aquatica and Mentha suaveolens. It is known for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and alleviating symptoms of nausea and headaches. The therapeutic actions of Bergamot mint include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Bergamot mint include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which contribute to its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
